title: 3 AI tricks that feel like magic

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know AI can now turn your voice into a celebrity’s?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This tech is changing how we create content faster than ever before.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It’s called voice cloning, and it uses just 30 seconds of audio to mimic someone’s voice.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The AI learns pitch, tone, and even speech patterns with incredible accuracy.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Marketers, filmmakers, and podcasters are using it to save time and money.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Remember: this tech is powerful, but always use it responsibly.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Have you ever heard a celebrity voice that sounded too real to be fake?

caption_text: 3 AI tricks that feel like magic
